name: limelit-open
description: Connect a self-hosted Limelit Open install: your own AI visibility tracking, read from Claude over the local limelit binary.

limelit_path.title: Path to the limelit binary
limelit_path.description: Absolute path to your limelit binary, for example /Users/you/limelit/limelit. `limelit serve` prints it at startup, under Claude Desktop.

data_dir.title: Limelit data directory
data_dir.description: Absolute path to your Limelit Open data directory (the folder holding limelit.db), for example /Users/you/limelit/data.
